Hong Kong Life Insurance Limited ("Hong Kong Life") was established in 2001 and is committed to providing customers with comprehensive and quality insurance and wealth management services through an extensive distribution network of approximately 130 distribution locations, including Chong Hing Bank, CMB Wing Lung Bank, OCBC Bank (Hong Kong), and Shanghai Commercial Bank.

We strive to provide quality insurance services and wealth management solutions to our valued customers, thus professionalism and talent of our staff is the key to Hong Kong Life's success.
